title: Catching Hallucinated Citations in Video-LLM Question Answering: A Self-Verification Pipeline and Verifier Ablation Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.15574v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video question answering systems built on vision-language models often produce timestamped claims with high confidence even when unsupported by the cited frame. This deceptive hallucination arises because timestamps imply grounding without ensuring correctness, increasing user trust but not accuracy. We introduce a pipeline that closes this loop. A retrieval-augmented language model drafts answers with per-claim timestamp citations, and each cited frame is independently re-examined before being shown to the user. We compare against a plain baseline and ablate three verification designs, evaluated on both Apple Silicon (MLX) and Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA). Directly asking the vision model whether a frame supports a claim fails completely (0% catch rate on 40 claims) due to sycophancy. Blind re-captioning plus a general LLM judge improves results but is unstable, oscillating between 0% and 100% flagged depending on prompt phras

translated_title: 视频-LLM问答中幻觉引用的捕捉：一种自验证流程与验证器消融研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15574v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于视觉语言模型的视频问答系统，在生成带时间戳的声明时，即使所引用的帧不支持该声明，也常表现出高置信度。这种欺骗性幻觉源于时间戳暗示了依据性却未确保正确性，从而增加了用户信任但未提升准确性。我们提出了一种闭环流程：检索增强语言模型生成带逐声明时间戳引用的答案，每个引用帧在展示给用户前被独立重新检查。我们与普通基线对比，并消融了三种验证设计，在Apple Silicon (MLX)和Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA)上评估。直接询问视觉模型某帧是否支持声明完全失败（40条声明中捕获率为0%），原因是谄媚效应。盲目重新生成字幕并配合通用LLM评判器可改善结果，但不稳定，根据提示措辞，标记率在0%至100%间波动。
tldr: 本文提出一种自验证流程，通过独立重检每个引用帧来捕捉视频问答中的幻觉引用，并发现直接询问视觉模型因谄媚效应完全无效，而重字幕加通用评判器虽有效但不稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-verification pipeline that independently re-examines each cited frame to catch hallucinated citations in video QA, finding direct visual model questioning fails completely due to sycophancy, while re-captioning with a general LLM judge is effective but unstable.
